'''Lucen-Tok''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Voss (species)|Voss]] [[Officer/Legends|Officer]] of the [[Voss commandos]] who lived during the [[Galactic War]]. Around [[3640 BBY]] he and his commandos visited the office of [[Athelis Kallis]] to warn Sith Lord [[Darth Nox|Kallig]] not to proceed with the [[Forbidden Ritual]].
